name: argonaute RISC catalytic component 2
pathways: positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: AGO2 encodes protein argonaute-2. Annotated molecular activities include RNA endonuclease activity and translation initiation factor activity. It participates in regulatory ncRNA-mediated post-transcriptional gene silencing and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Lessel-Kreienkamp syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
